title: Eligible GQR circles + affine completions close W1/W2/Walsh

algebra.eligible_span: Tangent pencils and a connected Cayley tangency graph show that edge-even nonsquare circles span H0 intersect ker(e_infinity+e_0). Connectivity follows from Katz's t=-2 Soto-Andrade bound.

algebra.completion: Nonsquare dilation transports h_T to a Max-minus completion of the standard nonsquare circle whenever 0 is in T.
algebra.pair_prescription: For outside transverse coordinates b,d, prescribe s_T(b)s_T(d)=chi(u-v). Equal coordinates force target +1; distinct coordinates permit equal or opposite membership and extension to |T|=(p+1)/2 for p>=5.
algebra.consequence: Every eligible circle is a U-difference, hence dir(U)=H0 intersect ker(e_infinity+e_0).
